attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Virginia state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in VA (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq apportionment.state_code get "VA" streq and

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets VA economic nexus threshold ($100K or 200 transactions)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.state_code get "VA" streq and

action_details.action_dsl: VA filing required due to physical presence
action_details.action_postfix: "VA filing required due to physical presence. Reference: VA Code 58.1-400" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_dsl: VA filing required due to economic nexus
action_details.action_postfix: "VA filing required due to economic nexus. Threshold: $100K OR 200 transactions. Reference: VA Code 58.1-612" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; No VA nexus - no filing requirement
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No VA nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Virginia state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VA state additions and subtractions; Calculate VA-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "VA income adjustments calculated. Reference: VA Code 58.1-402 (Modifications)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no state adjustments; No VA nexus - no adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No VA nexus - no adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Virginia state corporate income tax. Applies 6% flat rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax; apportionment.has_economic_nexus == true OR apportionment.has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus get true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence get true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate VA tax at 6% flat rate; VA income tax at 6% flat rate
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income get apportionment.state_tax_rate get mul /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "VA tax calculated at 6% flat rate. Reference: VA Code 58.1-400" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No VA nexus - no tax liability; No VA nexus - no tax
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No VA nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income; No VA taxable income - no tax
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No VA taxable income - no tax. VA NOL carryforward 15 years. Reference: VA Code 58.1-402.B.4" job.audit_trail swap addto
